name: suchewohnung
description: SucheWohnung — Aggregator for German apartment listings with Telegram notifications

scripts.build: npm run build -w @suchewohnung/shared && npm run build -w @suchewohnung/database && npm run build -w @suchewohnung/telegram && npm run build -w @suchewohnung/api && npm run build -w @suchewohnung/worker && npm run build -w @suchewohnung/bot && npm run build -w @suchewohnung/web
scripts.ci:supply-chain: npm audit --audit-level=critical && npm run license:check && npm run sbom:generate
scripts.license:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const lock=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package-lock.json','utf8'));const denied=/\b(?:AGPL|GPL|LGPL|SSPL)\b/i;const deniedAllow=[/^node_modules\/@img\/sharp(?:-|$)/];const missingAllow=[/^node_modules\/@suchewohnung\//,'node_modules/busboy','node_modules/passport-strategy','node_modules/pause','node_modules/streamsearch'];const allowed=(p,a)=>a.some((x)=>typeof x==='string'?x===p:x.test(p));const hits=[];for(const [p,x] of Object.entries(lock.packages||{})){if(!p.startsWith('node_modules/')||x.dev)continue;const license=String(x.license||'').trim();if(!license&&!allowed(p,missingAllow))hits.push(p+' <missing license>');if(license&&denied.test(license)&&!allowed(p,deniedAllow))hits.push(p+' '+license)}if(hits.length){console.error('License policy violations:\n'+hits.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}console.log('License check passed')"
scripts.smoke:deps: docker compose --profile smoke up --wait -d postgres-smoke redis-smoke
